{{Top|leg}}
The '''heat death of the Universe''' was the end of the universe and everything within it.

[[Cronal]] felt that his understanding of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] would allow him to exist until the end of the universe, its heat death, when he would be joined forever in the final oblivion of all that had ever been and would be.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Heat death of the universe|This concept]] is an accepted theory in modern cosmology.
